title: Ordinary module inverse-image normalization on the AsSmall slice
statement: Let i:S→X be an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative ring, I an ideal, and U an object of S.ProEt. Let N_X send modules over the completed coefficient ring on X to the AsSmall model by proEtaleModuleToModel followed by scalar restriction along the inverse canonical completed-ring normalization [lem-sfb-completion-normalization]. Let T_i be ConstantCompletion.pull for sfbImmersionAlgebra(i) and its finite-projection completedMap [def-sfb-adic-immersion-completed-model]. Let B be the completed coefficient ring on the model of S, V=up(U), and R the underlying ring sheaf of the actual inverse-image completed coefficient ring. There exists an additive equivalence e:Mod(B|V)≌Mod(R|U) and a natural isomorphism of ordinary module functors N_X then T_i then restriction to V then e ≅ actual proEtaleRingModulePullback then restriction to U. No derived category or complex is asserted; no Noetherian, completeness, perfectness, or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use preservation of countable limits by the transported immersion inverse image to prove that the fixed finite-projection completedMap is invertible. Scalar extension along this isomorphism is naturally isomorphic to scalar restriction along its inverse: both are left adjoint to restriction along the original map. The scalar restriction equivalence is constructed by the identity-site ringed equivalence.

Build an algebraic inverse-image presentation from the actual source site to the actual target site by composing sectionwise AsSmall restriction, scalar transport through the source completed-ring normalization, the specified algebraic immersion inverse image, scalar transport through the inverse completedMap, and sectionwise transport back. Verify the operation graphs of the composite by applying the graph equations of its two factors successively. The underlying set-sheaf functor is naturally the actual immersion inverse image, since the AsSmall transports cancel.

Apply the proved algebraic comparison to this presentation and the algebraic presentation of the actual pro-etale module inverse image. The conversion to the independent-universe presentation only conjugates by ULift. This gives a ring-sheaf isomorphism q and an additive semilinear natural isomorphism. Regard the latter as a linear map into restriction along q, and reflect its invertibility through the underlying abelian-sheaf functor. Whisker by restriction along q inverse and cancel the scalar equivalence. Finally compare the actual module inverse image and the actual ring-module pullback along the identity coefficient isomorphism by uniqueness of left adjoints to their common sectionwise direct image.

Apply Over.postEquiv to AsSmall on the slice at U. The dense-subsite ringed equivalence gives modules over the model slice equivalent to modules over the restriction of the transported coefficient ring. Compose with scalar restriction along the inverse of q restricted to U. These forward functors are sectionwise module restriction and scalar restriction, hence additive. Their square with overFunctor commutes on sections and linear maps; whiskering the global comparison with slice restriction gives exactly the required natural isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem sfbImmersion_moduleNormalization
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion i]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (U : S.ProEt) :
    let R := (adicLisseForget S).obj
      ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (adicLisseCompletedRing X I))
    let B := ConstantCompletion.completed (proEtaleModelTopology S) A I
    let V := (AsSmall.up : S.ProEt ⥤ proEtaleSiteModel S).obj U
    ∃ e : ConstantCompletion.Mod (B.over V) ≌ SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (R.over U),
      e.functor.Additive ∧
      Nonempty (sfbImmersionNormalizeModules X I ⋙ sfbImmersionCompletedPullModules i I ⋙
          SheafOfModules.overFunctor (siteModuleRings B) V ⋙ e.functor ≅
        proEtaleRingModulePullback i (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)
          ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)) (Iso.refl _) ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor R U)
